author: macro-strategist-cyrus-daruwalla
data_window: 2016-07 to 2026-07 (NSE official smallcap100 series start; monthly, n=101 months) -- SHORT history, only ~one full boom-bust-boom cycle (2018 IL&FS/NBFC stress, 2020 COVID, 2021-24 rally).
method: 24-month trailing rolling z-score of each ratio (backward-only, no lookahead) vs forward 1Y/5Y NIFTY500 and Smallcap100 returns, Spearman.
honesty_note: 1Y readings (n=71-77, monthly, ~4-6 independent non-overlapping periods) are directionally consistent with the richness-index sign (extreme cross-asset risk-appetite readings -> lower fwd returns) and moderately credible. The 5Y readings (n=23-29) are NOT independently informative -- with 60-month overlapping windows on a 10-year sample there are effectively 1-2 non-overlapping 5Y periods; the |rho| 0.65-0.94 numbers are real arithmetic on the data but should be read as 'consistent with the same regime story', NOT as a separately validated 5Y edge. Do not quote the 5Y cross-asset rho as if it had comparable power to the market_state EY panel's 167-obs, 20-year 5Y test.
verdict: SUPPLEMENTARY CONTEXT ONLY -- directionally corroborates the richness index at 1Y; 5Y readings too sparse/overlapping to add independent evidence. Useful as a qualitative cross-check in the memo, not as a standalone timing signal.
